lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎬᎩᏪᎭᎵ; ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᏲᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ ᏱᏙᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᎢ?  ᎠᎴ ᏝᏍᎪ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏱᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ?
lines.text: Na-hi-yu i-ga ge-se-s-di u-ni-tsa-ti-s-di hi-a nv-da-gv-gi-we-ha-li; Tsa-gv-wi-yu-hi, Tsa-gv-wi-yu-hi, tla-s-go de-tsa-do-v yo-tsv-di-s-ge yo-tsa-do-le-ho-s-ge-i?  A-le tla-s-go de-tsa-do-v yo-tsv-di-s-ge a-ni-s-gi-na yi-do-tsi-nu-go-wi-s-ge-i?  A-le tla-s-go de-tsa-do-v yo-tsv-di-s-ge u-tsa-ti u-s-qua-ni-go-di yi-do-gi-lv-wi-s-da-ne-he-i?
lines.english: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏪᏎᎵ; ᎥᏝ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᏨᎦᏔᎮᎢ; ᎤᏟ ᏫᏥᎶᎯ ᎤᏲ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ.
lines.text: Hna-quo-no hi-a nv-da-ga-tsi-we-se-li; v-tla i-lv-hi-yu yi-tsv-ga-ta-he-i; u-tli wi-tsi-lo-hi u-yo di-tsi-lv-wi-s-da-ne-hi.
lines.english: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎾᏂᎥ ᎩᎶ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎠ ᎠᎾᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏲᎯ ᏧᏁᏍᎨᎮᎢ;
lines.text: Na-s-gi i-yu-s-di na-ni-v gi-lo hi-a tsi-ni-tsi-we-a a-na-dv-gi-s-ge-s-di, a-le na-s-gi na-na-dv-ne-he-s-di, a-ga-ta-hna-i a-s-ga-ya do-da-ga-tsi-ya-tli-lo-s-ta-ni, na-s-gi nv-yo-hi tsu-ne-s-ge-he-i;
lines.english: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏧᎦᎿᎭᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏃᎱᎦᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏃᎸᏁᎢ, ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏥᏚᏱᎶᎴᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏲᏤᎢ, ᏅᏥᎯᏰᏃ ᎦᎧᎮᎢ.
lines.text: Hna-quo-no tsu-ga-hna-ne-i, a-le tsi-du-no-hu-ga-ne-i, a-le tsu-no-lv-ne-i, na-hna a-da-ne-lv tsi-du-yi-lo-le-i; a-se-no v-tla yu-yo-tse-i, nv-tsi-hi-ye-no ga-ka-he-i.
lines.english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
